title: Systematic Theology III: The Holy Spirit, the Church and Last Things
description: The final systematic theology course covers pneumatology (the person and work of the Holy Spirit), ecclesiology (the nature, marks, government, ministry and mission of the church), the sacraments (baptism and the Lord's Supper), and eschatology (death and the intermediate state, the return of Christ, the millennium, resurrection, judgment, heaven, hell and the new creation). Each disputed question is presented from the traditions' own sources and students weigh the arguments.
